motion.name: tap-bounce
motion.purpose: One-shot press feedback on every pressable (use:tapBounce).

components.name: Primary Round Button
components.description: Accent circle for the main live action (Nowbar play, search submit).
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-round" aria-label="Play"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-round { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; border: none; background: var(--color-primary, #0abab5); color: var(--color-on-primary, #0b0b0f); display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1); } .ds-btn-round:hover { background: var(--color-primary-hover, #09a49f); } .ds-btn-round:active { transform: scale(0.94); } .ds-btn-round:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-text, #f4f4f6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Hero Play Button
components.description: Inverted white circle; only on Now Playing.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-hero" aria-label="Play"><svg width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-hero { width: 62px; height: 62px; border-radius: 50%; border: none; background: #fff; color: #000; display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1); } .ds-btn-hero:active { transform: scale(0.94); } .ds-btn-hero:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #0abab5); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Sheet Button
components.description: Full-width 48px action in modals and sheets; danger variant filled coral.
components.css: .ds-btn-sheet { flex: 1; min-height: 48px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #888); background: var(--color-surface, #16161d); color: var(--color-text, #f4f4f6); font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1); } .ds-btn-sheet:hover { background: var(--color-surface-2, #1d1d27); } .ds-btn-sheet:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-sheet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #0abab5); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-sheet.ds-danger { background: #ff5a76; border-color: #ff5a76; color: #fff; }

components.name: Search Input
components.css: .ds-input-search { width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-surface-2, #1d1d27); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #888); color: var(--color-text, #f4f4f6); font-size: 0.9375rem; outline: none; } .ds-input-search::placeholder { color: var(--color-text-muted, #a0a0ad); } .ds-input-search:focus-visible { border-color: var(--color-primary, #0abab5); }

components.name: Tag Chip
components.description: Pill chip; selected state turns text and border to the accent.
components.css: .ds-chip { font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-surface-2, #1d1d27); color: var(--color-text-muted, #a0a0ad); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #888); cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover, .ds-chip.ds-on { color: var(--color-primary, #0abab5); border-color: var(--color-primary, #0abab5); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #0abab5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: List Row
components.description: 44px song row: 40px art, title, muted artist, trailing ⋮.
components.html:
光年之外
G.E.M. 邓紫棋
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 44px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--color-text, #f4f4f6); transition: background 120ms ease; } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--color-surface, #16161d); } .ds-art { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 6px; flex: none; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0abab5, #1d1d27); } .ds-meta { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-t { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-s { font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--color-text-muted, #a0a0ad); } .ds-opt { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; border: none; background: none; color: var(--color-text-muted, #a0a0ad); display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-opt:hover { background: var(--color-surface, #16161d); color: var(--color-text, #f4f4f6); } .ds-opt:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #0abab5); }

components.name: Scrubber
components.description: 4px track, accent fill, knob that swells to 1.7× under a drag.
components.css: .ds-scrub { position: relative; height: 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-scrub::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; height: 4px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--color-text-muted, #a0a0ad); opacity: 0.3; } .ds-fill { position: absolute; left: 0; height: 4px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--color-primary, #0abab5); width: calc(var(--f) * 100%); } .ds-knob { position: absolute; left: calc(var(--f) * 100%); width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-text, #f4f4f6); transform: translateX(-50%); box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1); } .ds-scrub:hover .ds-knob, .ds-scrub:active .ds-knob { transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1.7); }

components.name: Tabbar
components.description: 56px bottom nav, icon over micro label; becomes 88px rail at 1024px.
components.html: HomeSearchLibrary
components.css: .ds-tabbar { display: flex; height: 56px; background: var(--color-bg, #0b0b0f); border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border, #888); } .ds-tab { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; font-size: 0.625rem; color: var(--color-text-muted, #a0a0ad); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease; } .ds-tab:hover, .ds-tab.ds-active { color: var(--color-text, #f4f4f6); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #0abab5); outline-offset: -2px; }

narrative.overview: openmusic is a jukebox that fits in a thumb's reach: you drop a coin (a tap) and the record plays. The chrome is a dark cabinet, near-black and almost silent, so the only things that glow are the album art, the lyrics and one signal colour. At rest, every control is flat and quiet: thin hairline borders, tonal slate layers, no ornament. When you touch a control it responds physically, with a press-in bounce, a spring settle, or a scrub knob that swells under your finger. Restraint at rest and give under the thumb are the two halves of the same machine.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black cabinet, one signal accent, covers and lyrics as the only light sources.
Flat at rest, tactile on touch: `tapBounce` press, spring settles, a swelling scrub knob.
Depth through tonal slate steps and 1px hairlines; shadows only on things that float.
Pills and circles for anything you press; gentle 6–12px corners for anything you read.
Everything scales: text via root `rem` × `--fs-app`, covers via `--cover-scale`, home grid via `--home-grid-cols`.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Only one accent exists on a screen, and it always means "live, on, or go". Never use the accent for decoration, headings or illustration.

rules.name: The Role-Not-Hex Rule
rules.body: Components read `var(--color-primary)` and the surface tokens, never a literal colour. The user can repaint the cabinet at runtime, and a hard-coded hex is the one thing that won't follow.

rules.name: The rem-Only Rule
rules.body: Every `font-size` is in `rem`, multiplied by its `--fs-*` variable. A px font size ignores the user's text-size setting, so never add one.

rules.name: The Clipped-Title-Moves Rule
rules.body: A title too long for its box scrolls (`use:marquee`) instead of truncating into nothing. This motion carries information, so it survives reduce-motion.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-It-Floats Rule
rules.body: Surfaces on the page never cast shadows. Only something that sits above the page (a sheet, tooltip or knob) gets one.

rules.name: The Round-Means-Press Rule
rules.body: If a shape is fully round, it can be tapped. Readable content never uses a pill or a circle, except artist avatars, which are round to tell people apart from records.

dos: **Do** reference `var(--color-primary)` and the surface tokens. Accent and theme change at runtime.
**Do** put text and icons on a primary fill in `var(--color-on-primary)`, never a literal `#fff`.
**Do** keep 44px minimum hit targets on rows, icon buttons and inputs.
**Do** add `use:tapBounce` to every new pressable surface.
**Do** use the motion tokens: `--dur-quick` (160ms), `--dur-base` (240ms), `--dur-slow` (320ms), with `--ease-out-quint` for settles and `--ease-spring` for tactile snaps.
**Do** write font sizes in `rem` multiplied by the matching `--fs-*` variable.
**Do** gate hover styles behind `@media (hover: hover)` so touch never gets stuck hover states.
**Do** give every cover slot a gradient fallback (`coverGradient`). A missing cover must never show a broken image.
donts: **Don't** use a second accent colour or use the accent decoratively. Source brand colours stay inside source badges.
**Don't** put shadows on page-level surfaces. Use a tonal step or a hairline.
**Don't** make album or song art circular. Round is for buttons, chips and artist avatars.
**Don't** let motion that carries information (marquee, skeleton shimmer, loading spinners) stop under reduce-motion. Everything else must stop.
